def compute_icc31(M):
    n, k = M.shape
    gm = M.mean()
    rm = M.mean(axis=1)
    cm = M.mean(axis=0)
    SSt = np.sum((M - gm)**2)
    SSr = k * np.sum((rm - gm)**2)
    SSc = n * np.sum((cm - gm)**2)
    SSe = SSt - SSr - SSc

    FL = F / stats.f.ppf(0.975, n-1, (n-1)*(k-1))
    FU = F / stats.f.ppf(0.025, n-1, (n-1)*(k-1))
    return icc, (FL-1)/(FL+k-1), (FU-1)/(FU+k-1)
